title: Fresh Cobblemon
description: Fresh Cobblemon is a modpack designed to refresh the vanilla Minecraft experience, seamlessly integrating the Cobblemon with Vanilla+ mods.
body:
![Fresh Cobblemon Logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3d9566f321d07e7a2cc39e14e2aa7cd0b3674cec.png)

🍷 Fresh Cobblemon 🍷

Fresh Cobblemon is a modpack designed to refresh the vanilla Minecraft experience, seamlessly integrating the Cobblemon universe in a natural, balanced, and immersive way. Its goal is simple: expand the original gameplay without losing its identity, offering more adventure, exploration, and visual beauty.

Explore a living world where Cobblemon creatures spawn organically across biomes, encouraging curiosity and natural progression. Capture, train, and battle while venturing through caves, forests, villages, and structures that remain faithful to the vanilla spirit.

✨ Modpack Highlights:

🍇 Cobblemon fully integrated into vanilla Minecraft
Cobblemon mechanics fit smoothly into traditional survival gameplay, without exaggeration or broken balance.

🍷 Refined exploration
Carefully selected mods enhance world generation, add subtle details, and make every journey richer while keeping a clean, elegant visual style.

🕯️ Quality of life & smooth gameplay
Optimized interfaces, inventory improvements, and performance tweaks create a more comfortable and enjoyable experience.

🍾 Modern and sophisticated visuals
Handpicked shaders enhance lighting, shadows, water, and atmosphere.
Resource packs refine textures and visual details, preserving Minecraft’s classic style with a more polished, premium feel.

⚙️ Performance and stability
Fresh Cobblemon is designed to run well on different hardware setups, balancing advanced visuals with smooth performance and stability.

RAM:
6GB Minimum
8GB Recommended

🔥 Who is Fresh Cobblemon for?

Players who love vanilla Minecraft but want something new

Pokémon fans looking for an immersive Minecraft experience

Solo play or multiplayer sessions with friends

Explorers, builders, and adventurers

🍇 Fresh Cobblemon is the perfect union of tradition and innovation — a classic Minecraft experience, matured and full of discoveries.

[Motayyz](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/40af1540e710d88b061d9bf36933f6828574c97e.png): I am the creator of Fresh Cobblemon. A world where vanilla Minecraft has matured, come to life, and where new discoveries await you. Step in, explore, and experience something truly unique.

Please Enjoy! 🍷
